name: web_fetch
description: HTTP GET a URL and return its body (truncated). Default allowlist is api.github.com and raw.githubusercontent.com; extra hosts come from config web.allow. Input: {"url": "https://..."}. Returns {"ok": true, "bytes": N, "body": "..."}.
llm_description: HTTP GET a URL, return its (truncated) body. Default hosts: api.github.com, raw.githubusercontent.com (plus config web.allow). {url}.
